set.body: Build one installed computational workflow from recorded v4 source/recall situations through evidence-backed recall details, direct reference/conditional fidelity, and the three existing policy views. Add input-bound detail admission with exact expressed evidence, optional situation link, explicit address/discourse proposals and per-unit inventories; do not infer completed zero-detail work from graph construction. Preserve all v4 collections and original IDs through every update. Extend graph-free direct mapping and projection explicitly to v4 without silent downgrade, and retain exact v1-v3 schema/prompt/recording behavior. Use versioned profiles for new schemas; no old-request widening that changes frozen replay contracts. Add positive and adversarial witnesses for state-linked details, processing gaps, duplicate/foreign claims, context/support ownership, preserved existing bindings, and source reuse across two recalls. No paid/provider/private-data runs. Broader recall grouping, summaries, event qualifiers, playback and remaining full P2/P3 capabilities stay owed.
set.title: P2.5 Connect rich recall details to recorded mapping and scientific views
